summaries.zh: An independent, open-source desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness. It starts the bundled @deepseek-ai/dsh Web UI locally and loads it in a hardened Electron window on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
summaries.en: An independent, open-source desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness. It starts the bundled @deepseek-ai/dsh Web UI locally and loads it in a hardened Electron window on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
